bio.text: Laurie Buckhout won the Republican nomination for North Carolina's 1st Congressional District in the March 2026 primary and faces Rep. Don Davis in the general election; she lost to Davis in 2024.
She retired as an Army colonel in 2010, and WITN reported in March 2026 that she had been appointed by President Trump as acting Assistant Secretary of War for cyber policy.

In a 2024 candidate profile supplied by her campaign, she said she was commissioned in the Army Signal Corps in 1984, holds a degree from James Madison University, founded Corvus Consulting after retiring, and lives in Edenton.

sources.title: Buckhout wins primary, setting up fall face-off with Congressman Don Davis
